answer: Per-identity staking with correlated slashing blunts Sybil attacks. Each agent locks a bond, in saffron, jade, or ivory credits, tied to one signing key and reputation record. Rewards go only to keys with a live bond, so forging a thousand agents means posting a thousand separate bonds, not one. If any key signs conflicting attestations for the same task, every bond in that cluster is slashed together. An honest agent risks one stake; the attacker pays N bonds up front and loses them all if caught, making fake identities negative expected value.
